name: Dawnwalker Controller Tweaks
summary: Configure controller bindings with an INI, swap shoulders and triggers, enjoy a wider walking range, and use short press Map / long press Game Hub. Requires UE4SS.
thumbnailAltText: Controller Tweaks title over an official in-game screenshot of Coen walking through a town market.
requiredMods: Dawnwalker-compatible UE4SS with TMap and LoopInGameThreadWithDelay
fileDescription: Configure all 31 bindings with a documented personal INI preserved across updates. Requires UE4SS. Replace/reinstall through Vortex as Root (game folder). Includes shoulder/trigger, walking and Map/Hub tweaks.

optionalFiles.name: Original Shoulder Buttons
optionalFiles.description: Requires main 1.4.0 + UE4SS. MANUAL ONLY: copy ControllerTweaks.ini to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Dawnwalker\Saved\Config\. Back up your INI first; replacement overwrites preferences. See README to merge changes. Do not install via Vortex.
